name: The Last Nordic Tribe
detailed_description:
Have you ever wondered what shaped the brutality of the Vikings? What past forged these fierce warriors?

"The Last Nordic Tribe" is a RPG game with survival elements set in the brutal realities of the early Middle Ages. The story is set long before the first Viking invasions, at the end of the third year of an unusually harsh three-year winter, known as the "Little Ragnarök," spanning the years 536-539 AD. This tragic period claimed the lives of 95% of Scandinavia's population, and the memories of these events were preserved centuries later on the Rök Runestone – a warning to future generations.

The game's story has been crafted from scratch, drawing on the limited historical information available. Fictional elements were added, such as storylines involving the remnants of Roman culture along the Amber Road, the theme of slavery, and the unequal struggle against overwhelming adversity — frost and hunger.

Your mission is to survive at all costs, utilizing survival elements like gathering resources and crafting weapons from available components. Encounters with enemies will provide not only valuable experience but also essential materials for survival.

The game recreates the atmosphere of the time – land covered in volcanic ash, barren trees, wooden buildings, and the characteristic aesthetics and culture of the early Middle Ages. All of this combines to create a dark and immersive experience that transports players to the unforgiving world of the "Little Ragnarök."

Can you survive in a world where history was never meant to be so brutal?

short_description: The Last Nordic Tribe is an RPG with survival elements, set in the brutal world of the Little Ragnarök (536–539 AD). Fight hunger, frost, enemies, and fate itself as you journey through the dark beginnings of the Middle Ages. Will you be able to survive?

content_descriptors.notes:
Adult content is an integral part of the game's narrative and reflects its survivalist nature, the harsh realities of early medieval life, and the overall tone of the world depicted. While such content is present, it is neither excessive nor graphic, and it serves a clear narrative and gameplay purpose.

The concept of "human meat" is a fictional survival resource, available only in extreme in-game situations. It is neither encouraged nor rewarded, and it is not depicted in graphic detail. This mechanic is grounded in the fantasy/survival setting and is not intended to glorify violence, cannibalism, or gore in any form.
